dedupe_keys.name: merit flowtopo code the c and python implementations and the figure scripts for a reusable computational foundation for hyperresolution hydrology on the global 90 m drainage network

description: Lulu Jiang and colleagues publish MERIT-FlowTopo code for ordering and processing high-resolution drainage networks. Zenodo provides separate C, Python and paper-figure archives under MIT. The public description says the C version constructs serial orderings and parallel layerings on a 90 m MERIT Hydro flow network; a small example basin of 731 square kilometres and 93,432 cells is bundled for method reproduction. The Python implementation is intended for use on other networks. These tools can prepare flow-routing topology before hydrological or flood simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this topology processor. The global scope refers to compatibility with MERIT Hydro tiles, not a bundled global hydrography dataset. A limitation is that baseline DEM, flow-direction and accumulation tiles must be obtained separately under MERIT Hydro terms; the example excerpt retains those upstream terms. The code and large network inputs were not downloaded, and reported speed or numerical agreement was not reproduced.
